subject.title: refactor: store gateway restart recovery in SQLite

question: Is the focused migration and queue evidence sufficient to accept this restart-state cutover and its shared delivery-queue semantic changes after rebasing onto current main?
rationale: The remaining choice is not a mechanical defect: maintainers must accept the compatibility and message-delivery risk of retiring the shipped sidecar path and extending shared persisted queue semantics.

options.title: Rebase and approve the cutover
options.body: Refresh against current main and land after exact-head checks and owner review confirm the existing migration and retry coverage remains valid.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Hold merge until a real upgrade from v2026.7.1 demonstrates preservation of a pending legacy sentinel plus transient restart-notice recovery.

options.title: Narrow the shared queue changes
options.body: Pause the PR and redesign restart-specific ownership if maintainers do not want permanent receipts and per-entry retry budgets in the generic queues.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve the cutover
recommendation.body: Refresh against current main and land after exact-head checks and owner review confirm the existing migration and retry coverage remains valid.

likelyOwner.reason: VACInc introduced the restart wake, routing, and bounded retry behavior whose compatibility must be preserved.
